ios.desc:
noflair - Your home bar in your pocket

The best app for managing your home bar and deciding which cocktail to drink tonight!

Discover the key features of our cocktail and home bar app:

Home Bar Inventory
- Easily add your bottle collection by scanning the barcode of each individual item.
- Top up your inventory with generic and homemade ingredients like syrups, juices, and more.
- Search and filter across your cocktail books selected from an ever-growing library.
- Create your own drink recipes and homemade ingredient recipes.

Cocktail Recipes
- Browse an extensive collection of cocktail recipes, inclusive of offerings from books and creative mixes from other users.
- Instantly identify which cocktails you can prepare with the ingredients you currently possess.
- Enjoy smart cocktail recipe suggestions, specifically tailored to utilize ingredients nearing their expiration.

Search & Filter
- Discover the perfect cocktail for any occasion using our advanced search and filter features. Search by name, ingredients, flavours, and sources to uncover new favourites or locate specific recipes.
- Identify drinks you can craft using a particular product.
- Determine your next bottle purchase with filtering options such as ingredient type, brand, flavour, or region of production.

Community Interaction
- Join in engaging discussions with other users about drinks, spirits, bars, and the app itself.
- Share your creative recipes with fellow cocktail enthusiasts directly within the app.
- Every user is empowered to contribute, correct, and enhance product data.

Additional Features...
- Conveniently switch between metric and US customary measurement units.
- Bookmark interesting drinks and products to easily remember what you're excited to try next!
- Rate drinks and spirits to ensure your favorites are always at your fingertips!
- Create flavour profiles and compare them with the discoveries of other users.

I created a home bar app for organising my bottles and drink recipes.
Now other people use it too, but I still sometimes struggle with prioritising features for myself instead of building for others.
